title: Nested include! slice A, wiring: 27 `mod name { include!() }` test blocks become `#[path] mod name;`
outcome: 27 blocks under src/tests of the form `mod name { include!("f.rs"); }` (8 of them with `use super::*;` before the include) become `#[path = "f.rs"] mod name;` declarations, so that each fragment is an ordinary module file that `cargo fmt` reaches. The module keeps its name and its place, so module paths and libtest names are expected not to change. Where the block held `use super::*;` and the file has no such line, the line moves into the file. Follows the formatting-only candidate of the same slice (sibling item). The 12 blocks of codex_reviewer_mcp_startup.rs and of the federation_* files are left out because in-flight candidates change those files; they go to a later slice. The 27 blocks are listed in a note on this item.
acceptance: On the candidate, none of the 27 listed blocks remains; each is a `#[path = "f.rs"] mod name;` declaration with the same module name, and this item's contribution to the candidate commit changes no file other than the 27 fragments and their parents; every other path the commit changes belongs to another item, whose contribution is recorded with it.

The set of test names printed by `cargo test --bin termal -- --list` is the same on the candidate as on the candidate without this item's contribution, on one host; for a candidate that holds only this item's contribution that is its parent.
No test reads or pins source text for this change.

completion.summary: 27 test modules under src/tests that were written as `mod name { include!("f.rs"); }` are now `#[path = "f.rs"] mod name;` declarations, so each file is an ordinary module that cargo fmt reaches; module names, nesting and test names are unchanged, and one duplicate `use super::*` warning is gone. Landed on master in the batch commit 4de80b74 together with one other item; both full gates passed on that exact commit and the evaluation passed all four criteria. The 12 blocks in codex_reviewer_mcp_startup.rs and the federation test files were left for a later slice.
